name: gramatr
description: Real-time intelligent context engineering that makes every prompt cheaper, faster, and context-aware.
tagline: Patent-pending real-time intelligent context engineering for every AI tool you use.
long_description: grāmatr℠ is a patent-pending real-time intelligent context engineering layer that sits between you and every AI model you use. Every prompt runs through a multi-head classification pipeline that pre-routes the request, assembles behavioral directives and quality criteria, and pulls relevant context from past work — so the model skips orientation overhead and starts working immediately. It replaces the tens-of-thousands-token system prompt you'd otherwise hand-maintain, and the effect compounds the longer you work. Because the same contract — directives plus quality gates — runs on every prompt, behavior stays consistent and auditable across sessions, tools, and teammates: your AI acts the same on session 200 as on session 1, so you spend less time re-explaining and more time shipping. Works across Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, and VS Code.
featured_use_cases: Resume yesterday's project from any AI tool, on any device
Save your preferences once — every assistant respects them
Pre-classified prompts mean faster, cheaper answers
Quality checks and structured execution baked into every task
Consistent AI behavior across every session — same standards, same quality gates, same preferences, every time.
Autonomous agent work held to the same standards — every turn adjudicated against your contract
Less re-explaining, less drift — productivity that compounds across sessions
